literal: For nobility, touchstone what, if asked: defeat, equal those-who-are-not from-even, accepting.
translation: If asked what the touchstone of true nobility is, it is the willingness to accept defeat even from one's inferiors.
modern: சான்றாண்மைக்கு உரைகல் எது என்றால், தமக்குச் சமம் இல்லாதவர்களிடமும் தோல்வியை ஏற்றுக்கொள்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate test of a noble character. The word 'கட்டளை' refers to a touchstone used to test the purity of gold, here representing the standard for testing nobility ('சால்பு'). The true measure of such greatness is the humility to accept defeat ('தோல்வி கொளல்'). Crucially, this defeat is accepted not just from equals or superiors, but even from those who are not one's equal ('துலை அல்லார்'), demonstrating profound modesty and the absence of ego.
